mapper.select: SELECT 'chatSessions' AS metric_key, count(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= #{todayStart}) AS today_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= #{sevenDaysStart}) AS last7_days_count FROM chat_session UNION ALL SELECT 'chatMessages', count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{todayStart}), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{sevenDaysStart}) FROM chat_message UNION ALL SELECT 'chatFailures', count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{todayStart}), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{sevenDaysStart}) FROM chat_failure UNION ALL SELECT 'chatFeedback', count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{todayStart}), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{sevenDaysStart}) FROM chat_feedback UNION ALL SELECT 'searches', count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{todayStart}), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{sevenDaysStart}) FROM search_log UNION ALL SELECT 'searchPiiBlocks', count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{todayStart}), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{sevenDaysStart}) FROM search_block_log UNION ALL SELECT 'crawlFailures', count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{todayStart} AND status = 'FAILED'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{sevenDaysStart} AND status = 'FAILED') FROM crawl_run_log UNION ALL SELECT 'unreviewedCrawlFailures', count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{todayStart} AND status = 'FAILED' AND reviewed = FALSE), count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{sevenDaysStart} AND status = 'FAILED' AND reviewed = FALSE) FROM crawl_run_log UNION ALL SELECT 'activeScenarios', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') FROM scenario
mapper.sql: id, title, content, enabled, starts_at, ends_at, priority, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notice WHERE enabled = TRUE AND (starts_at IS NULL OR starts_at <= #{now}) AND (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at >= #{now}) ORDER BY priority ASC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, enabled, starts_at, ends_at, priority, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{enabled}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, #{priority}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, enabled = #{enabled}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, ends_at = #{endsAt}, priority = #{priority}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notice SET enabled = FALSE, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: id, name, type, enabled, endpoint_env_key, previous_endpoint_env_key, rate_limit_per_hour, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_channel (name, type, enabled, endpoint_env_key, previous_endpoint_env_key, rate_limit_per_hour, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{enabled}, #{endpointEnvKey}, #{previousEndpointEnvKey}, #{rateLimitPerHour}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_channel SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, enabled = #{enabled}, endpoint_env_key = #{endpointEnvKey}, previous_endpoint_env_key = #{previousEndpointEnvKey}, rate_limit_per_hour = #{rateLimitPerHour}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: id, event_type, source_type, source_id, severity, summary, status, attempt_count, last_error, next_retry_at, reviewed, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_event SET status = #{status}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notification_event SET reviewed = TRUE, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
